evidence.result: Built-in chain on a 2 s 48 kHz signal: 200 Hz tone 14.16 dB below the no-highpass reference (>= 12, pass); 5 kHz tone -0.16 dB (pass); loud 5 kHz limiter output peak 0.00 dBFS against a -1.0 dBFS threshold (fail, hard clip at 1.0); reruns byte-identical; 16-bit WAV round trip max diff 4.4e-5 (pass). Python 3.12.2, numpy 2.5.5, macOS arm64.
evidence.scope: Built-in highpass, compressor, gain and limiter on generated tones and noise, macOS arm64: highpass, reruns, 16-bit WAV pass; limiter peak not held to threshold (fail); no plugins

summary: Python audio-effects library that chains built-in processors and can host VST3 or Audio Unit plugins. Native plugins, their permissions and compatibility must be assessed separately.
use_when: Apply effects or host supported plugins in Python
Prototype an offline audio processing chain
avoid_when: Basic audio conversion and muxing: FFmpeg
license: GPL-3.0 for project code; bundled libraries and third-party plugins have separate terms
